description_en: Modifies the status of a protection template
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-defense-template-status --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 2249 --template-status 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDefenseTemplateStatus

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the protection rule template
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the protection template that you want to set. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的防护模板状态。取值：
0：表示关闭。
1：表示开启
parameters.name: template_status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the dry run mode. If you do not specify this parameter, a normal request is sent. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request. The system checks whether the request meets the execution conditions without performing the specified operation. If the dry run fails, the corresponding error code is returned. If the dry run succeeds, the error code Defense.Control.DryRunOperation is returned.
false: Sends a normal request. The specified operation is performed after the request passes the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启 DryRun 预检模式。如果不输入该参数，表示发起正常请求。取值：
true：表示发起预检请求，仅检查请求是否满足执行条件，不执行请求指定的操作。预检不通过时返回相应错误码；预检通过时返回错误码Defense.Control.DryRunOperation。
false：表示发起正常请求；检查通过后执行请求指定的操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
